title: Build an AI-enabled team with explicit roles, permissions, review gates, and accountable owners.
summary: Aloha AI helps organizations design human and agent workflows that allocate work without obscuring responsibility, authority, confidentiality, or quality control.
audience: Leaders introducing agents, automation, or AI-assisted operations across functions.
timeline: A bounded team and workflow design engagement generally begins with a 2–4 week diagnostic and architecture phase.
fit: Teams are using multiple AI tools without coordination
Work is duplicated or dropped between people and systems
Agent access and authority are unclear
evidence: Representative tasks, errors, and approval histories
methodology: Decompose work into decisions and tasks
assumptions: Access controls can be configured and audited
limitations: Agents do not become accountable professionals
Automation quality depends on system access, evaluation coverage, and maintained instructions
